name: Prenecrotic: The Cursed School VR
languages: English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese*languages with full audio support
short: VR psychological horror where you're desperate to find your lost wife in a abandoned school. Explore decaying halls, uncover dark secrets, and survive twisted supernatural encounters. Use tools, instincts, and courage to endure the nightmare before it consumes you forever.
about: ENGAGING STORY  Step into the shoes of  Jason , a man desperate to uncover the truth behind his wife's mysterious disappearance inside a remote and decaying school. What begins as a simple search spiral into a nightmarish descent through shadowed hallways, blood-soaked classrooms, and twisted alternate realities.       HORROR VR EXPRIENCE  Built from the ground up for  Virtual Reality ,  Prenecrotic  delivers a deeply immersive and psychologically disturbing horror experience. Face terrifying, otherworldly creatures, gather cryptic clues, and solve environmental puzzles to uncover the school’s cursed history — and the secrets it’s dying to keep.  🔑  Key Features :     VR-Only Immersion  Every scare, every sound, every shadow — feel it all in full virtual reality.     Narrative-Driven Horror  Uncover a dark, emotional story as you piece together your wife's final steps.     Tense Exploration & Survival  Use found tools and instinct to survive unpredictable encounters.     Reality-Bending Mechanics  Shift between worlds using a cursed doll to unlock new paths — and new horrors.     Atmospheric Puzzle Solving  Decipher cryptic messages, keys, and blood-stained notes to progress deeper into the darkness.        “If you’re interested, don’t forget to add to your Wishlist – it really helps us!”
